lede: Wat Chiang Man accounts for 137 catalogued manuscripts, 41 of them flagged research-priority. It clusters in Chiang Mai (99% of the corpus for this temple), ahead of Mueang District. Nearly all (100%) are written in Tham Lanna · อักษรธรรมล้านนา script. By support it leans to palm-leaf · ใบลาน (72%) over mulberry paper (saa) · กระดาษสา (28%). Dated witnesses run 1743–1952 CE (60 of 137 carry a date).
